name: Pact of the Blade
description: Manifest the agreement in a weapon. Use a Bonus Action to conjure or bind an eligible melee weapon; gain proficiency, Charisma option for attacks and damage, and Warlock focus use; choose ordinary, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage per attack. Follow the host's modern bond and ending restrictions.
deepenedAtLevel5: Attack twice with your Pact weapon during one Attack action; this is intrinsic and does not cost an Invocation. Devouring Blade can upgrade this to three attacks total. Thirsting Blade is not a selectable option.
